meta.name: placement-exclusion-manager
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build my brand-safety exclusion lists", "set placement / topic / content exclusions before launch", "add network and audience exclusions", or "prep the A1 brand-safety evidence for the auditor"; produces a placement/network exclusion list, a content-suitability & sensitive-topic block list, an audience/negative-audience exclusion set, and a packaged A1 brand/placement-safety evidence file for the gate. Not for building the audiences you target — use audience-segment-builder; not for computing the RQS or issuing the A1 verdict — use ad-account-auditor. 品牌安全/排除位置/否定受众列表

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成品牌安全排除列表与受众排除集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在广告投放前设置排除项并通过品牌安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Generate brand-safety exclusion lists and audience exclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set exclusions before ad launch and pass brand-safety audits.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的广告账户和目标，生成品牌安全排除列表，包括位置、网络、内容适宜性和敏感话题的屏蔽，并打包成审计证据文件。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建品牌安全排除列表”、“设置投放前的位置/主题/内容排除”、“添加网络和受众排除”或“准备审计用的品牌安全证据”时触发。

say.text: 为我的广告账户构建品牌安全排除列表，目标是在Google上做直接响应广告。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供投放报告，然后生成排除列表。

say.text: 设置投放前的位置和网络排除，排除新闻和政治类内容。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的品牌安全约束并生成排除方案。

say.text: 打包A1品牌安全证据文件，供审计员使用。
say.note: Claude 会整合投放报告和排除决策，生成证据文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate brand-safety exclusion lists based on your ad account and goal, including placement, network, content-suitability, and sensitive-topic blocks, and package them into an audit evidence file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build my brand-safety exclusion lists", "set placement/topic/content exclusions before launch", "add network and audience exclusions", or "prep the A1 brand-safety evidence for the auditor".

say_en.text: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my ad account targeting direct-response on Google.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your placements report and then generate exclusion lists.

say_en.text: Set placement and network exclusions before launch, excluding news and political content.
Package the A1 brand-safety evidence file for the auditor.
